title: spectrum-bins/1: a unit-resolution spectrum cut into mass bins, `mzlab-cli spectrum get --bin`
description: The points of a window summed into half-open bins [bin - width/2, bin + width/2) around integers (rule nominal) or tenths (rule 0.1), on the m/z minus the offset. CSV (`--format csv`) has the header bin,mz,counts,points. Code: crates/mzlab-cli/src/spectrum_bins.rs, crates/mzlab-core/src/nominalbin.rs (the route /api/spectrum with rebin= and mzoff=).

sample.description: Sample id of a multi-sample file (.wiff); null for an mzML.

rule.description: What the bins are around: whole numbers or multiples of 0.1.

mz_offset_da.description: The offset (observed - true, Da) taken off every m/z before the cut; 0 when none was given.

mz_offset.description: {"mode":"fixed"} for a number (or none), or the evidence of an auto:MZ[@RT] estimate (mode auto, ion_mz, rt_min, status ok|wide|not_found, n_scans, apex_rt_min, apex_intensity, spread_da, snr).

bins.description: The bins in order of m/z, those with no point left out.

bin.description: The integer (nominal) or multiple of 0.1 the bin is around.

mz.description: Centre of mass of the points on the corrected scale (m/z minus the offset), weighted by intensity.

counts.description: Intensity summed over the points (the mean over the scans of a window).

points.description: Profile points (or centroids) summed into the bin.

evidence.description: route (/api/spectrum), query (the route query with rebin and mzoff), scan (scan_id, scan_no, rt_min, ms_level; level_auto when the file's only level was chosen) and answer (the route's own scalar members: mode, rule, width_da, edges, mz_offset_da, mz_offset, scans, i0, i1, n, sid).
